title: What class are you?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What tells you more about someone's social class: income, education, job, accent, lifestyle, or something else?
Do you think people are less aware of class differences today than in the past?
Can people easily move from one social class to another?
Should social class matter when discussing inequality and opportunity?
Have you ever noticed people being judged because of their accent, neighbourhood, or background?
